Exchanges.Text:
Hi Gate team-b, welcome to today’s standup!  
Our sprint goal is that customers can pay by card, and failed payments will retry automatically, with 6 days left in the sprint.
Thanks for the update. I’ll let Daniel take the floor now and then we’ll wrap.

Daniel, what did you finish, and what’s next?  
Is the summary page work for story 3 done, is story 4 and task 19 done, and is task 15 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.
Okay, I’ll note your commitment and then continue with the next part.
Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: I’m adding idempotency keys to payment requests today.
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.  
Maya, for story 5, is the “I’ll chase them today” commitment done, and for bug 12 and story 2, is your earlier plan done; then tell me what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
I’m going to gently steer this back to today’s standup.

Let’s take that offline, and I’ll add it to the parking lot.  
Maya, please carry on with your update.
That's everything from me.
Maya, who can help unblock this, since you’re blocked on access to the platform team’s staging gateway?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.
Thanks, I’ve captured that commitment and I’ll keep the focus here.

Maya, you’ve committed to pairing with Daniel on staging access today.  
Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.

Blocker noted: waiting on the security review.  
Commitment noted: I’ll chase them today.
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

You finished the refund API tests.  
You’re now working on the payment retry story.  
No blockers were reported.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Recap: the team is blocked on staging gateway access from the platform team, and security review is still pending.  
We’ve parked the side discussion about the gateway timeouts between Daniel Park and Admin for offline follow-up.  
Task 19 and task 15 are flagged as stale, at risk, and missed commitments, and the owners will get follow-ups in Teams.  
No one was absent or missed, and follow-ups for anyone who did not respond, if any, will also come in Teams—thank you, everyone.
